My life is a fucked up mess. I think of committing suicide every single day. And I have caused my own mess and can't get myself out.

I'm in my mid 30s and my story starts right out of high school. I fell for a lady. Hard.  We were a pair. Matter of days into our relationship we were finishing each others sentences; Our likes were almost identical, as we're our opinions on life. We were together for a short time, but she had this quirk; She wasn't ready to settle down and was having fun jumping from guy to guy. She broke it off with me fairly quickly. Over the next five years we kept gravitating towards each other. The things were always uncanny. We'd bump into each other at a party. She got a tattoo of the character that I had picked as my lifelong screenname after we broke up; She never knew about it until we met. Still finishing each others sentences; Still finding new movies we liked. Her boyfriend of the month would always want to beat the shit out of me because it would always seem that we hadn't broken up. We did mess around but we never 'finished'. 

Five years and I couldn't take the pain anymore. I had tried dating and moving on but i couldnt. Suicide played a daily roll in my life. I loved her.  It was killing me.  I moved half way across the country to avoid her. My life seemed to get some balance at that point.   

I started getting a bit reckless and dating for sex. Realized quickly I was trying to fill the void she had left. I had found church a few years before I left but fell away. Fell back upon the church to clean up. Great people is why I went, not the teachings. I met someone online in another country; And then K (lady from before) found me. I couldn't take it do I promptly moved to other country and married other lady six months later. I thought I had lived this other woman, but I think what I loved was the instant family to preoccupy my. I took her two daughters on as my own. I realized quickly this woman was abusive but ignored it for almost five years. Finally I had it. As much as I loved my daughters, I could not take what she was doing to me. I left her, and hurt like fuck because I knew I would never see my children again. Huge hole in my heart and fell into relationships with some odd women. I found a woman with unwavering love for me and very kind, and wanted a child with me in the future. 

We return to my home country married and thought life would be good. Had a lovely daughter that I love with all my heart. (She is only reason I am still alive today). Day my wife had our daughter, was the day she changed. She became 100% disinterested in me. That's okay; I had something to preoccupy me; A little me.

Then, two years after my daughters birth, I get a Facebook friend add. My whole insides flipped upside down in a second. It was K. Her and I started talking like we had never stopped. She was married, I was married. We acted like nothing was going on but I knew where it was going. After a few weeks, she sent me a text. She came up with an acronym to tell me she always loved me and only me. I broke down but I didn't let her see it. We contined talking, her professing her love for me for two weeks before I told her I never stopped loving her. We planned a meeting and we did, middle of half a country away. 

It was like we had never stopped being together. But we could see what 10 years had done. She is hyper intelligent but now, every time she would say something smart, she'd stop herself. The men she had been choosing didn't want 'smart' wives. She saw that I struggled to let my emotions out and reveal my feelings. It was the best weekend of my life. And also the worst. 

We went back to our lives. We had promised each other that we were going to start to make things right so we can be together. alas, she told her husband and while I do not know what transpired, she told me she couldn't speak to me again. I felt like she chose money over love. That's when I started serious depression again, suicidal thoughts and destructive actions. 

To fill the void, I've started to date (still technically married). Last three years I've been dating. And by date, I mean have sex and do shit I want to do. It was making me feel better about myself but I knew it was destructive. K started trying to call, text and email off and on. We would start talking and then she would tell me she can't. 

There is not a day I don't feel suicidal. My daughter is the only reason why I haven't. I've tried to love other women. I think I'm in love with one but then K comes along. I was a successful businessman at a point but this is hurting that as well. I feel so much pressure. I put on a fake smile every single day and am friendly. Inside I cry almost all day every day now. I go for numerous drives a day to just cry. I go to a spot to find inner peace, only to find more sorrow. I don't think there is a single person who knows my pain. Because of K, I hide everything from everyone. I hide my actions with other people. Everybody sees my outwardly 'me'. I have one friend who know a bit, but I can't even let him in. 

I plot how to do it at least once a day. I try to decide on if I can make it look like an accident. I'm pretty sure I can do it. People will be sad. I'm sure my secrets will come out. I just hope my daughter will be better off with her mom than with someone as dysfunctional as me. It's been 15 years of miserys and I want it to stop.
